queries: WITH r AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name, SUM(t.Bytes) * 1.0 / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS rate FROM MediaType m JOIN Track t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name) SELECT Name, rate, rate - (SELECT AVG(rate) FROM r) AS excess_over_average FROM r WHERE rate > (SELECT AVG(rate) FROM r) ORDER BY rate DESC

WITH r AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name, AVG(t.Bytes * 1.0 / t.Milliseconds) AS rate FROM MediaType m JOIN Track t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL AND t.Milliseconds > 0 GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name) SELECT Name, rate, rate - (SELECT AVG(rate) FROM r) AS excess_over_average FROM r WHERE rate > (SELECT AVG(rate) FROM r) ORDER BY rate DESC

WITH r AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name, CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) AS REAL) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS rate FROM MediaType m JOIN Track t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name), a AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate FROM r) SELECT r.Name, r.rate, r.rate - a.avg_rate AS excess_over_average FROM r CROSS JOIN a WHERE r.rate > a.avg_rate ORDER BY r.rate DESC

responses.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name, SUM(t.Bytes) * 1.0 / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS rate FROM MediaType m JOIN Track t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name) SELECT Name, rate, rate - (SELECT AVG(rate) FROM r) AS excess_over_average FROM r WHERE rate > (SELECT AVG(rate) FROM r) ORDER BY rate DESC

assumptions.assumption: A media type's rate is total Bytes divided by total Milliseconds over its tracks (a pooled ratio), not an average of per-track ratios.
Tracks with NULL Bytes are excluded from both the numerator and denominator so the rate isn't distorted.
The 'simple average' is the unweighted mean of the per-media-type rates, so each media type counts equally regardless of track count.
Media types with no tracks are excluded (inner join), and the results are ordered by rate descending.

alternatives.interpretation: Each media type's rate is the mean of per-track Bytes/Milliseconds ratios rather than the pooled ratio.
alternatives.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name, AVG(t.Bytes * 1.0 / t.Milliseconds) AS rate FROM MediaType m JOIN Track t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL AND t.Milliseconds > 0 GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name) SELECT Name, rate, rate - (SELECT AVG(rate) FROM r) AS excess_over_average FROM r WHERE rate > (SELECT AVG(rate) FROM r) ORDER BY rate DESC

assumptions.assumption: A media type's rate is its total Bytes divided by its total Milliseconds across its tracks (a ratio of sums), not an average of per-track ratios. Tracks with NULL Bytes are skipped in the numerator by SUM, but their Milliseconds still count in the denominator.
The 'simple average' is the unweighted mean of the per-media-type rates, so each media type counts equally. Media types with no tracks are excluded, as the request specifies.
Results are not rounded, and CAST to REAL avoids integer division.

alternatives.interpretation: Each media type's rate is the average of per-track Bytes/Milliseconds ratios. Tracks with NULL Bytes are excluded.

assumptions.assumption: A media type's rate is its pooled rate: total Bytes divided by total Milliseconds across its tracks (SUM(Bytes)/SUM(Milliseconds)); tracks with NULL Bytes are ignored in the numerator but still count in the denominator's milliseconds.
The 'simple average' is the unweighted mean of the per-media-type rates, computed only over media types that have at least one track (inner join).
Results are not rounded; excess = rate minus the average.

alternatives.interpretation: Media type rate is the average of each track's own Bytes/Milliseconds ratio (mean of per-track rates) rather than the pooled ratio.
